title: Debian 决定不禁止 AI 代码进入其 Linux 发行版
summary: Debian 项目通过投票决定，允许开发者在其 Linux 发行版的开发、维护和文档编写过程中使用 AI 工具。新政策承认，负责任地使用 AI 可以提高开发者的生产力，并指出生成式 AI 并非被豁免或特别限制，而是需要遵循现有的质量标准和伦理准则。这一决定意味着 Debian 不会像某些其他开源社区那样全面禁止 AI 生成的代码，而是采取开放但审慎的态度。政策强调，AI 辅助的贡献仍需经过人工审查，确保代码质量、安全性和许可证合规性。此举反映了开源社区对 AI 工具日益普及的适应，同时也引发了关于 AI 在开源项目中角色和责任的讨论。Debian 作为重要 Linux 发行版，其政策可能影响其他开源项目的决策。
summary_en: Debian has voted to allow developers to use AI tools in their contributions to the Linux distribution's development, maintenance, and documentation. The new policy acknowledges that responsible use of AI can improve productivity and states that generative AI is neither exempt nor specially restricted, but must adhere to existing quality and ethical standards. This decision means Debian will not ban AI-generated code outright, unlike some other open-source communities, but will take an open yet cautious approach. The policy emphasizes that AI-assisted contributions still require human review to ensure code quality, security, and license compliance. This move reflects the growing adoption of AI tools in open-source communities and sparks discussions about the role and responsibility of AI in open-source projects. As a major Linux distribution, Debian's policy may influence decisions in other open-source projects.
